text: Geology focuses on the study of the Earth system, aiming to understand the formation and evolution patterns of the Earth. The research scale is extremely wide: ranging from the microscopic mineral crystal structure (micron scale) to the macroscopic plate movement (global scale), from the brief seismic activity (second scale) to the long-term mountain uplift (billion-year scale). Core objective: To answer fundamental questions such as "How was the Earth formed?" "How did the surface morphology evolve?" "Where are the mineral resources distributed?" "How do geological disasters occur?" Disciplinary attributes: It combines theoretical and practical aspects. It is a discipline closely intersecting with engineering, environmental science, biology, etc. within the field of natural sciences, and serves as a fundamental support for resources, energy, environment, and engineering fields.
